meta.title: Provider setup checklist
meta.step_1: Create account with credentials and save.
meta.step_2: Run Test to fetch webhook URL/token and validate access.
meta.step_3: Copy Webhook URL and Verify token into Meta webhook settings.
meta.step_4: Subscribe required webhook fields in provider console and send a test event.
meta.step_5: Return here and run Test again to confirm status is connected.

telegram.title: Telegram setup checklist
telegram.step_1: Create Telegram account with bot token.
telegram.step_2: Use Set webhook to register CRM public endpoint in Bot API.
telegram.step_3: Run Test to verify bot access and webhook diagnostics.
telegram.step_4: Use Delete webhook when rotating or disabling integration.
